inventory.title: A shopper adds a product to the cart and sees the cart reflect it
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on Sauce Labs Backpack
Check button, badge and cart link

inventory.title: A shopper builds a multi-item cart and removes one item from the list
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on Bike Light, Onesie, Fleece Jacket
Click 'Remove' on the two remaining items

inventory.title: After sorting by price high to low the shopper adds the first listed product and the right item is added
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on the first product

inventory.title: A shopper opens a product's detail page and it matches the list entry
steps: Click the title link of Bolt T-Shirt
Click the image link of Backpack

inventory.title: The cart contents survive a page reload and a detour to a product detail page
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on Bolt T-Shirt
Open a product detail page and click 'Back to products'

inventory.title: Every sort option orders the product list correctly
steps: Select 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', 'Price (high to low)', 'Name (A to Z)' in turn
Read names and prices after each
